A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, probably Helena or Theodora. Mint uncertain, AD337-340, (Reece period 17). Reverse is illegible, reverse legend reads [ ]. Obverse shows draped bust right. Obverse legend reads [ ] (AVG). Condition is fair. Weight is 1.60g, diameter is 15.40mm
